attributes.action: General election due to prime minister stepping down. The people need to decide.
attributes.additional_details:
Prime minister Kier Starmer has stepped down.
The public should get a chance for another General election to vote who leads the country. The British country and its people are divided and unhappy with many issues a general election is needed to firmly decide who leads the country it cannot be decided behind closed doors by back room deals. This should be the British people’s decision.
The British people need to be heard this will solve much of the devision and unrest  firmly and fairly.
attributes.background: To give the public a chance to vote for the leader of the Country. The prime minister is stepping down he has lost his own parties confidence. Labour has lost the faith of its supporters and the uk public in general it’s only fair to let the British people decide who runs the government and country
